# Function notes

<!-- generated by `efh notes render` from content/notes/FN-*.json; edits here are overwritten -->

Recorded behaviour of Excel's worksheet functions that an implementation matching Excel needs,
or that explains a result a user did not expect: quirks, answers that differ from the
mathematical value, details of the arithmetic needed to reproduce Excel's last bit, and places
where Microsoft's documentation differs from behaviour. Every note gives exact binary64 inputs
and Excel's recorded answer, the Excel build and machine of the reading, and the evidence. A
note marked measured is read off recorded Excel answers over its stated scope; inferred marks
what goes beyond them. How to add a note: [HOWTO.md](HOWTO.md). Format:
[`tools/schemas/f20-function-note.schema.json`](../../tools/schemas/f20-function-note.schema.json).
Machine-readable: [`site/api/notes.json`](../../site/api/notes.json).
